No sorry/admit/new axiom/Shrink/ULift/PUnit. All 12 #print axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

=== MAIN FINDING (changes the plan) ===
S1853GlobalTracePerfect / S1853GlobalTraceDuality are NOT missing local-to-global lemmas: as literally stated they are FALSE in general. Cause: Mathlib defines
  LinearMap.trace R M = if h : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M) then traceAux R h.choose_spec.some else 0
so Algebra.trace / Algebra.traceForm are JUNK ZERO on any module without a finite basis. Hence for a finite étale R'-algebra A that is not a free R'-module, Algebra.traceForm R' A = 0, and a nondegenerate zero form forces Subsingleton A.

PROVED (in the file):
* trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis, traceForm_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis, subsingleton_of_traceForm_eq_zero.
* S1853GlobalTracePerfect_iff_free_or_subsingleton :
    S1853GlobalTracePerfect ↔ ∀ A : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale R', (∃ finite basis of A) ∨ Subsingleton A.
  I.e. the literal target is a FREENESS statement about finite étale R'-algebras, not a trace statement.
* not_S1853GlobalTracePerfect_of_nonfree and not_S1853GlobalTraceDuality_of_nonfree:
    given A finite étale R', Nontrivial A, and no finite R'-basis, both targets are FALSE.
  (Existence of such an A is NOT formalised — that would need Pic(R') ≠ 0 / class group of the Weierstrass curve. So this is a conditional refutation, but it already shows the target cannot be the intended content: even if all finite étale R'-algebras were free, S1853GlobalTracePerfect would reduce to the free case plus a hard Picard computation, and S1853GlobalTraceDuality would not follow as a formal condition.)

=== WHAT IS PROVED (the true fragment of the "assembly") ===
1. traceForm_nondegenerate_of_free : for A : FiniteEtale R' with [Module.Free R' A], (Algebra.traceForm R' A).Nondegenerate.  The local-to-global step S1853 thought was missing IS available and is used here:
   isUnit_det_traceMatrix_of_isLocalRing (unit determinant over a local ring, extracted from S1853's local proof)
   + Algebra.traceMatrix_localizationLocalization at every prime
   + isUnit_of_forall_isUnit_algebraMap_atPrime (unit criterion)
   + nondegenerate_of_isUnit_det (S1853).
2. S1858GlobalTracePerfectLocal (UNCONDITIONAL, proved as S1858GlobalTracePerfectLocal_proof): ∀ A, ∀ maximal p of R', the trace form of the R'_p-algebra R'_p ⊗[R'] A is nondegenerate. This is the strongest true trace statement available.
3. S1858ProjectiveTraceGluing (plain Prop, NO inhabitant) = the exact first missing input: a single bilinear form on each finite étale A whose localisation at every maximal p is the trace form of the free localised algebra. It is INHABITED IN THE FREE CASE (S1858ProjectiveTraceGluing_of_free, via Algebra.trace_localization), so it is not vacuous. It is not dischargeable for non-free A because Mathlib 4.32.2 has no trace for finite projective modules (dual-basis trace) and Algebra.trace_localization needs Module.Free.

=== WHAT THE PARENT SHOULD DO ===
* Do not consume S1853GlobalTracePerfect / S1853GlobalTraceDuality for S1849EqualRankInclusion or for "R' field6". They are unusable/false; any closure resting on them would be fake.
* S1849EqualRankInclusion remains genuinely missing. Its real content is triviality of the different for finite étale algebras over a normal domain (= perfectness of the trace form of a finite projective algebra + the integrality/duality step). Two Mathlib-level gaps:
  (a) trace/traceForm for finite projective modules with base-change compatibility (= the S1858ProjectiveTraceGluing interface);
  (b) "finite étale over a normal domain is integrally closed in its generic fibre" (Serre criterion/normality of étale algebras) — also absent.
* Concrete next executable step: implement (a) (define trace of an endomorphism of a finite projective module via a splitting M → R^n → M; prove well-definedness, multiplicativity, and trace_localization without Module.Free). Then S1858ProjectiveTraceGluing becomes provable (finite free cover + Zariski gluing of M → M*), and S1853GlobalTraceDuality can be restated for that projective trace; only then can the S1849 trace-duality argument run.
* I did NOT edit coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md or AUDIT_LEDGER.md (shared files, other agents active). Please record: "S1853GlobalTracePerfect is false as stated (junk Algebra.trace on non-free modules); free case proved; exact missing input is a projective trace form (S1858ProjectiveTraceGluing); S1849EqualRankInclusion still missing".
* No other file was modified; S1858 imports only the existing olean of S1853TraceFormActual plus Mathlib localization files, so existing build state is untouched. Probe/scratch files were deleted.
